HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

3. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   C. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   B. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.
   C. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.

7. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   B. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   C. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. C — Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Nairobi

9. A — Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Plan income and spending wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Colonialism in Contemporary Society; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
